latest.title: Stateful MCP Servers on ECS Fargate: What Happens When You Deploy
latest.description: This article investigates running a stateful MCP (Model Control Plane) server on AWS ECS Fargate. After outlining hosting options like Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, and Fargate and I run a PoC that performs rolling deployments while sessions are active to see real-world behaviour. The post compares trade-offs, surfaces unexpected results, and provides practical guidance for architects deciding how to host MCP servers on AWS.
